description: Creates or updates the store's own tax registrations, matched by ItemId, then by name.

items.description: A tax registration: where the store collects a tax, under which number.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

JurisdictionId.description: The id of the tax jurisdiction the store is registered in.

TaxType.description: The tax type the registration covers, or none for every type.

RegistrationNumber.description: The number the tax authority gave the store.

IsActive.description: Whether the store collects the tax under this registration.

ThresholdAmount.description: The sales above which the store must collect the tax, or none.

ThresholdAccumulatedAmount.description: The sales recorded into the jurisdiction so far, measured against ThresholdAmount. It is kept up to date as sales are recorded, so it is usually left out.

RegistrationDateUtc.description: When the tax authority granted the registration.

MerchantTaxRegistrations.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
